principle: No dataset enters training or a commercial evaluation until provenance, license and permitted purpose are verified from the rights holder.

datasets.name: COde
datasets.modality: Mixed PaX, periapical, CBCT slices, photographs and longitudinal clinical text
datasets.annotations: Diagnosis, treatment plan, treatment and follow-up text
datasets.fit: Best public candidate for image-to-treatment research; no prices, mixed modalities, single-center and 448 px images

datasets.name: MMOral-OPG Training
datasets.license: not visible before gated access review
datasets.fit: Highly relevant to radiographic interpretation, but no verified treatment-price labels

datasets.name: MMOral-OPG Bench
datasets.license: MIT benchmark release; source images Apache-2.0 and CC-BY-4.0 per paper
datasets.fit: External interpretation benchmark including summary/recommendation QA; not confirmed treatment-plan or price supervision

datasets.name: OralXrays-9
datasets.annotations: Nine detection classes including missing teeth, implants, crowns and pathology
datasets.license: not stated by the official repository/paper
datasets.fit: Strong perception benchmark; describes findings or existing work, not recommended treatment

datasets.name: ToothPix
datasets.fit: Useful for lesion segmentation, not treatment plans or prices

datasets.name: DENTEX
datasets.annotations: Quadrants, tooth enumeration and four diagnosis classes
datasets.license: conflict: official GitHub says CC-BY-SA-4.0; official Hugging Face says CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
datasets.fit: Useful non-commercial tooth/disease research, not product training or treatment pricing

datasets.name: InReDD PAN924
datasets.annotations: FDI numbering and twelve dental conditions/restorations
datasets.license: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0
datasets.fit: Charting/detection research only; no treatment plan or price labels

datasets.name: Tufts Dental Database
datasets.modality: Panoramic radiographs with expert interaction traces
datasets.annotations: Teeth, abnormalities, eye tracking and radiologist think-aloud
datasets.license: Official request form limits use to non-commercial research/education
datasets.fit: Radiology reasoning research; no treatment plan or price labels
